replay_method: Re-derive the arbitrary-k family without using the primary result as an assumption. Check source validity, P7-freeness, nonterminal reachability, connected-Q_ALL persistence and injectivity of the canonical profile map.

root_source_state: S={t,s4} is connected by edge t-s4.
Every dynamic vertex sees s4 but not t, so no outside vertex is complete to S and every dynamic source list is {1,2,3}.
z is the unique nonfixed vertex anticomplete to S, so Y0={z}.
Y0 has no edge, so axiom (iv) is vacuous.
Exactly R sees z and every such vertex has the same source 3-list, so axiom (vi) holds.
P7_free: On bipartition (L union {z}, R), the neighborhoods are nested: N(l1) subset ... subset N(lk)=R=N(z). Hence this induced subgraph is a chain graph and has no induced P5 because an induced P5 contains an induced 2K2 on its first/last edges.
Every L/R vertex is adjacent to s4. In an induced path containing s4, any L/R vertex beyond an immediate path neighbor of s4 would create a chord to s4.
t has degree one and only attaches to s4. Therefore no induced P7 can use s4 or t either.
authorized_subset_forcing: Only l1,...,l_{k-1} are optional; lk is retained.
L is stable, so previously forced left vertices create no new forbidden color on an unforced left vertex.
Every unforced left vertex therefore keeps color 1 available.
z is anticomplete to L, so Y0 is never removed by this forcing.
global_SAT_reachability: For every subset F, color all L with 1, all R with 2, z with 3, s4 with 4 and t with 3.
All chain edges are 1-2, z-R edges are 3-2, seed edge is 3-4, and s4-dynamic edges are 4-(1 or 2).
Thus every prefix/subset state is globally extendable and nonterminal.
canonical_closure: No source singleton arises: unforced left vertices remain 3-list, while a right vertex either remains {1,2,3} or shrinks to {2,3}.
X0 remains empty and no connectivity repair occurs.
z remains the sole residual component.
Every right vertex remains live; lk remains live and is adjacent to every right vertex.
connected_QALL: The component carrier [z] is adjacent to every right vertex.
lk is adjacent to every right vertex.
Hence Q_ALL remains one connected block for every forced subset.
profile_injection: The component carrier [z] canonically marks R as its dynamic neighborhood.
Therefore the dynamic vertices outside N([z]) are exactly the surviving left vertices.
For a surviving li, its number of neighbors in R is exactly i.
The set of these distinct degrees is exactly {i: li not in F}.
Hence the canonical profile uniquely recovers F and there are exactly 2^(k-1) profiles.
component_side_control: C={z} has fixed base list [4] because X0 stays empty and D_C=R throughout.
Its message is good on every proper color mask and bad only on [4], so MIN_BAD={[4]}.
Thus the exponential profile multiplicity is not caused by changing component message identities.
